-# Cortex — read the rules before you code
-
-This repository is governed by two things you must read before editing anything:
-
-1. [`AGENTS.md`](mdc:AGENTS.md) — how to build, run and test this app, plus the
-   non-obvious traps (native modules under two ABIs, why the renderer cannot call
-   the API directly, product scope).
-2. [`.rules/`](mdc:.rules/00-overview.md) — the coding rules, each with bad and
-   good examples. Start at `00-overview.md`, then open the file for the surface
-   you are touching:
-
-   - [`01-security.md`](mdc:.rules/01-security.md) — no tokens in the renderer, no secrets in git, guest vs signed-in
-   - [`02-errors.md`](mdc:.rules/02-errors.md) — never show a vendor name to a user
-   - [`03-responsive.md`](mdc:.rules/03-responsive.md) — 390 / 768 / 1440, dark + light, tokens not hex
-   - [`04-structure.md`](mdc:.rules/04-structure.md) — `packages/app` vs `packages/cortex-api`, no fake data
-   - [`05-documentation.md`](mdc:.rules/05-documentation.md) — docs ship with the code
-   - [`06-product.md`](mdc:.rules/06-product.md) — Chat ≠ Code ≠ Bot
-   - [`07-git-and-prs.md`](mdc:.rules/07-git-and-prs.md) — branches, commits, required attestation
-   - [`08-testing.md`](mdc:.rules/08-testing.md) — which suite proves which claim
-
-## The short version
-
-- The product is **Cortex**; the domain is **`cortex.foundation`**; UI copy is
-  **English**. No other assistant brand and no internal codename in code, copy,
-  docs, commits, branches, or PR titles.
-- **Never name a vendor in user-facing copy.** Say which Cortex capability is
-  affected and what the user can do next.
-- **One renderer: `packages/app`, SolidJS.** No React. Design values come from
-  `@cortex-ide/tokens` through `@cortex-ide/ui` — no raw hex, no magic spacing.
-- **Honest states.** Empty, loading, error and signed-out are real states. Never
-  fake success, never seed fake rows, never present a cache as a live answer.
-- **Secrets stay in main.** Nothing that authenticates anything reaches the
-  renderer or the repository.
-- **Chat and Code are peers.** Code is a real cloud dashboard (sessions,
-  review, automations) per Paper Concept 03 — not a chat clone. Bot is a
-  separate desktop app, not a third tab here.
-- **Every PR carries the attestation** in
-  [`.github/pull_request_template.md`](mdc:.github/pull_request_template.md), and
-  a PR that changes product surfaces, routes, environment, or error copy updates
-  `AGENTS.md` in the same PR.
-
-Before opening a PR: `bun run typecheck`, `npx eslint packages`, `bun run test`,
-`bun run test:discovery`.

-# Cortex (Chat + Code + Bot) — environment variables
-#
-# Copy to .env and fill in what you need. Nothing here is required: with no
-# provider configured the app still runs, and Settings is where keys are meant to
-# live. Settings takes precedence over these variables — the most recent explicit
-# gesture wins, and an inherited shell variable that silently overrode a key you
-# had just typed would make the form look broken.
-#
-# Keys entered in Settings are held by the Electron main process and encrypted
-# with the OS keychain where one is available. They are never returned to the
-# renderer, which is also why the renderer cannot call a provider directly.
-
-# Debug Mode
-DEBUG=false
-
-# Development
-NODE_ENV=development
-VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173
-
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# Cortex
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# The model catalogue at /v1/models is public, so the picker shows the real
-# Cortex models signed out, marked locked. Inference needs an account.
-# CORTEX_API_BASE_URL=https://api.cortex.foundation
-# Web renderer only. Leave unset on localhost so the suite never opens a
-# guest session. Staging CI sets this to the staging API later. A
-# *.cortex.foundation origin also enables /v1/realtime (WS, then SSE, then
-# HTTP conversation turns).
-# VITE_CORTEX_API_BASE_URL=
-
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# Custom provider — any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# This is the same code path as the built-in providers, not a fallback: OpenRouter,
-# Together, Groq, vLLM, LM Studio and an internal gateway all expose
-# POST /chat/completions, and what distinguishes them fits in these fields.
-#
-# Example, driving OpenRouter as a plain gateway:
-#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
-#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_API_KEY=sk-or-v1-…
-#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_ID=openrouter-gateway
-#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_LABEL=OpenRouter gateway
-#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_DEFAULT_MODEL=cohere/north-mini-code:free
-#
-# Settings accepts several endpoints at once; the environment carries one, because
-# encoding a list in a variable needs a format to parse and document for a case
-# the environment does not serve.
-# CUSTOM_PROVIDER_BASE_URL=
-# CUSTOM_PROVIDER_API_KEY=
-# CUSTOM_PROVIDER_ID=custom
-# CUSTOM_PROVIDER_LABEL=Custom provider
-# CUSTOM_PROVIDER_DEFAULT_MODEL=
-
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# Built-in providers
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# A keyed provider without its key is left unregistered rather than registered to
-# fail on first use, so an absent key reads as "not configured" rather than as a
-# broken provider.
-# OPENAI_API_KEY=
-# OPENAI_BASE_URL=
-# OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL=
-
-# ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=
-# ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=
-# ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL=
-
-# OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
-# OPENROUTER_BASE_URL=
-# OPENROUTER_DEFAULT_MODEL=
-
-# GROK_API_KEY=
-
-# Ollama runs locally without authentication, so its host alone activates it.
-# OLLAMA_HOST=http://localhost:11434
-# OLLAMA_ENABLED=true
-
-# Which provider a session uses when none is specified.
-# DEFAULT_AI_PROVIDER=
-
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# Paper design pipeline
-# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-# The design lives in a Paper file and is pulled, not transcribed. Needed only to
-# regenerate tokens, icons and baselines — see `bun run paper:sync`.
-# PAPER_MCP_URL=https://…/mcp
-# PAPER_MCP_AUTH=Basic …
-# PAPER_FILE_ID=
-
-# Optional: Sentry (Error Tracking)
-# SENTRY_DSN=your-sentry-dsn
-# SENTRY_ENABLED=false

-# GitHub Actions Workflows - Monitoring System
-
-Ce dossier contient un système de monitoring automatique 24/7 pour Cortex IDE.
-
-### Staging (`staging.yml`)
-- **Trigger:** push to `staging`, or manual
-- **Environment:** GitHub `staging` (production is separate)
-- **Builds:** web (`packages/app/dist`) + Electron Linux unpacked dir on CodeBuild (`codebuild-cortex-gha-arm64-…` or `x64`)
-- **Deploy:** OIDC-ready (`id-token: write`). Off until `STAGING_DEPLOY_ENABLED`. No AWS keys in git.
-- **Must not** write the production desktop update feed (R2 `cortex-releases` / `releases.cortex.foundation`).
-
-### Publish staging feed (`publish-staging.yml`)
-- **Trigger:** `workflow_dispatch` with a full 40-character SHA that is on `origin/main`
-- **Dist:** Linux electron-builder on CodeBuild, `publish.url` baked to `https://software.cortex.foundation/staging/`
-- **Feed:** rclone copy to R2 `cortex-software/staging/` when `STAGING_FEED_ENABLED`. Refuses destination containing `cortex-releases`
-- See [`docs/runbooks/desktop-staging-prod.md`](../../docs/runbooks/desktop-staging-prod.md)
-
-### Build and Release (`build.yml`)
-- **Trigger:** version tag `v*.*.*`, or manual
-- **Jobs:** matrix package (mac / win on GitHub-hosted; linux on CodeBuild) → GitHub Release → `publish-feed`
-- **Feed:** rclone copy to R2 bucket `cortex-releases` (objects at the bucket root). Custom domain `releases.cortex.foundation`. Always also publishes `software.cortex.foundation/latest/`. Generic provider URL in `electron-builder.yml`. Production macOS/Windows fail closed without signing credentials; notarization uses electron-builder's built-in hook.
-- **Gate:** GitHub Environment `production` and `vars.PRODUCTION_DEPLOY_ENABLED == 'true'`
-- **Secrets (production environment):** `R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID`
-- See [`docs/releases.md`](../../docs/releases.md)
-
-## 📋 Workflows Disponibles
-
-### 1. **Continuous Monitoring** (`continuous-monitoring.yml`)
-- **Fréquence:** Toutes les 15 minutes
-- **Objectif:** Surveillance continue de la santé du projet
-- **Checks:**
-  - ✅ Build compilation
-  - ✅ TypeScript type checking
-  - ⚠️ Linting
-  - 📊 Métriques de code (LOC, fichiers, tailles)
-- **Outputs:** `MONITORING_LOG.md`
-- **Alertes:** Crée une issue GitHub si le build ou TypeCheck échoue
-
-### 2. **E2E Monitoring** (`e2e-monitoring.yml`)
-- **Fréquence:** Toutes les heures
-- **Objectif:** Tests end-to-end automatisés avec Playwright
-- **Checks:**
-  - 🧪 Suite complète de tests E2E
-  - 📸 Screenshots et traces
-  - ♿ Tests d'accessibilité (axe-core)
-- **Outputs:** `E2E_MONITORING_LOG.md`
-- **Artifacts:** Rapports HTML, screenshots, traces
-- **Alertes:** Issue + commentaire PR si échec
-
-### 3. **Security Audit** (`security-audit.yml`)
-- **Fréquence:** Quotidien (2h UTC)
-- **Objectif:** Audit de sécurité complet
-- **Checks:**
-  - 🔒 Audit des dépendances (vulnérabilités)
-  - 🔑 Détection de secrets hardcodés
-  - 🛡️ Vérification des best practices
-  - 📦 Analyse des dépendances obsolètes
-- **Outputs:** `SECURITY_LOG.md` + rapport détaillé
-- **Alertes:** Issue critique si secrets détectés ou +10 vulnérabilités
-
-### 4. **Performance Benchmarks** (`performance-benchmarks.yml`)
-- **Fréquence:** Quotidien (3h UTC)
-- **Objectif:** Métriques de performance
-- **Checks:**
-  - ⏱️ Temps de build
-  - 📦 Taille des bundles (main, renderer, preload)
-  - 📊 Complexité du code
-  - 🚀 Estimation du temps de démarrage
-  - 📝 Performance TypeScript
-- **Outputs:** `PERFORMANCE_LOG.md` + rapport détaillé
-- **Alertes:** Issue si régression détectée (build >120s, bundle >10MB)
-
-## 🎯 Logs de Monitoring
-
-Tous les logs sont automatiquement mis à jour dans le repo :
-
-- `MONITORING_LOG.md` - Santé globale (15min)
-- `E2E_MONITORING_LOG.md` - Tests E2E (1h)
-- `SECURITY_LOG.md` - Sécurité (quotidien)
-- `PERFORMANCE_LOG.md` - Performance (quotidien)
-
-## 🚨 Système d'Alertes
-
-Le système crée automatiquement des issues GitHub pour :
-
-- ❌ **Build ou TypeCheck échoué** (label: `monitoring-alert`)
-- 🧪 **Tests E2E échoués** (label: `e2e-failure`)
-- 🚨 **Alertes de sécurité critiques** (label: `security-alert`)
-- ⚠️ **Régressions de performance** (label: `performance-regression`)

-## 🔄 Déclenchement Manuel

-```bash

-# Ou via GitHub CLI :
-gh workflow run continuous-monitoring.yml

-gh workflow run security-audit.yml
-gh workflow run performance-benchmarks.yml

-

-

-

+name: CI
+on:
+  pull_request:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]

+concurrency:
+  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true

+jobs:

+    name: Lint, typecheck, unit tests, i18n audit
+    runs-on: ${{ startsWith(vars.CORTEX_LINUX_X64_RUNNER, 'codebuild-') && format('{0}-{1}-{2}', vars.CORTEX_LINUX_X64_RUNNER, github.run_id, github.run_attempt) || vars.CORTEX_LINUX_X64_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with: { node-version: 22 }
+      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
+        with: { bun-version: 1.4.2 }
+      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
+      - run: bun run lint
+      - run: bun run typecheck
+      - run: bun run test
+      - run: bun run audit:i18n
+
+  e2e:
+    name: E2E (Playwright + Electron, Linux)
+    runs-on: blacksmith-4vcpu-ubuntu-2404
+    timeout-minutes: 30
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with: { node-version: 22 }
+      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
+        with: { bun-version: 1.4.2 }
+      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile && node node_modules/electron/install.js
+      - run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y xvfb
+      - run: bun run build
+      - run: xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1920x1080x24" bun run test:e2e
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: e2e-linux
+          path: |
+            test-results/
+            playwright-report/
+
+  macos:
+    name: macOS build, package, launch
+    runs-on: blacksmith-6vcpu-macos-26
+    timeout-minutes: 40
+    env:
+      CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: false
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with: { node-version: 22 }
+      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
+        with: { bun-version: 1.4.2 }
+      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile && node node_modules/electron/install.js
+      - run: bun run build
+      - name: E2E on macOS (source build)
+        run: bun run test:e2e
+      - name: Package (unsigned, arm64)
+        run: npx electron-builder --mac dir zip --arm64 --publish never -c.mac.identity=null -c.mac.notarize=false
+      - name: Packaged smoke test
+        run: node scripts/smoke.mjs mac
+      - name: Crash logs
+        if: always()
+        run: mkdir -p out && cp ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports/*.ips out/ 2>/dev/null || true
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: macos
+          path: |
+            out/
+            test-results/
+            playwright-report/
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        with:
+          name: cortex-mac-arm64-zip
+          path: dist/*.zip
+          retention-days: 7

-  **English**. No other assistant brand and no internal codename in code, copy,
